title: Water observations from space: Mapping surface water from 25 years of Landsat imagery across Australia
lineage: Publisher or operator text. Local file preserves selected passages and research notes.

passages.locator: Introduction; Section 2.1 Landsat archive; Section 3 Methods
passages.note: The underlying archive is the 1987–2014 Landsat 5 and Landsat 7 imagery over Australia, processed to approximate 25 m pixels and organised into time-series tiles. The team applied a decision tree to estimate water presence per scene/pixel, then summarised those observations. The product was publicly accessible at the time of writing.
passages.quote: The core dataset is the Australian archive of Landsat-5 and Landsat-7 data from 1987 to 2014.

file.method: Selected, claim-specific paraphrases and short excerpts from the cited passages.
